pages.title: Usage
pages.one: The accounts helpers spend on, their limits and order, and switching before one runs out.

steps.text: You set limits and the order
Keeps the first account that is under its limit and stays under for 10 more minutes
All near their limit: one warning on Home

good: Usage keeps only names, numbers and rules, never a login. With a share set it also picks the tool and model for each new helper.
